subject: PillarHealth — privacy & compliance follow-up: DPA intake and SCC pathing
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@pillarhealth.com>, PillarHealth Security <security@pillarhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: DPA intake + SCC choices after today's call

Hi Samir / Pillar security team —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps:

- SOC 2: you flagged SOC 2 type II evidence as helpful for procurement. We're SOC 2 type II (in-scope: infra, change mgmt, access controls). I've attached a one-page summary and can share the full report under NDA/SSAE channels.
- HIPAA/GDPR: you asked whether Redwood can support HIPAA-covered workloads and GDPR controller/processor mappings. Short answers: Redwood supports HIPAA under our Private deployment + BAA; for hosted API we generally act as processor — customers are controllers. We can discuss alternate arrangements for Dedicated/Private.
- DPA / SCC module: you requested a DPA template and guidance on SCC selection. Attached is our standard DPA template and a short note on SCC module options (we support the EU Commission's SCCs and can adopt the processor-to-controller module where appropriate).
- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): you mentioned a short questionnaire your security team prefers. I've attached a blank copy and can pre-fill sections (SOC 2 references, encryption, access controls) if you want.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm the Pillar primary reviewer for legal/security (Samir? legal@pillarhealth.com?).
2) If we can act as processor for your use case, confirm by reply — otherwise flag if Pillar needs Redwood to be a joint controller.
3) We will:
   - Kimberly (cc'd) will route DPA to legal and note any expected redlines to expect back.
   - David (cc'd) will assemble SOC 2 artifacts and a short engineering security summary.
   - I will schedule a short follow-up (15–20 min) to walk the DPA + SCC options once you confirm reviewer and target timeline.

Attachments: redwood-dpa-template.docx; redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf; vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks — happy to be flexible on format.

Best,
Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first high-performance LLM inference
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@pillarhealth.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: PillarHealth Security <security@pillarhealth.com>, legal@pillarhealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: DPA intake + SCC choices after today's call

Thanks Elliot — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side before we loop legal:

- Controller/Processor: our default expectation for SaaS vendors is that we remain the controller and the vendor is the processor. There are a handful of integrations where we have joint-determination questions (e.g., where data transformation includes model outputs stored in our system). For now treat this as processor-only unless we flag otherwise.
- SCCs: we need to confirm which SCC set you're prepared to sign (2021 EU Commission SCCs vs older modules). Can you confirm which exact module your DPA references and whether you can accept the processor-to-controller clauses?
- SOC 2 evidence: we will need an artifact showing last audit date and in-scope systems. If you can provide the abbreviated summary that helps speed procurement; we will request the full report via secure upload later.

Next steps for us: I'm the security reviewer initially — legal@pillarhealth.com will do contract review. Please pre-fill the questionnaire where you can; we'll aim to have first review by next Wednesday 28 April.

Thanks,
Samir Gupta
Information Security Manager, PillarHealth
samir.gupta@pillarhealth.com

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com, legal@pillarhealth.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: DPA intake + SCC choices after today's call

Samir — thanks for the quick clarifications, good call. Two short answers and a proposed path forward: 

- SCC set: Redwood's current standard references the 2021 EU Commission SCCs. We have a processor-to-controller addendum we can attach to the DPA for EU transfers. I'll attach the specific SCC module reference in the DPA we send.
- Controller/Processor: per your note we'll treat Pillar as controller and Redwood as processor for the standard hosted offering. If Pillar later requires joint-controller terms we can escalate to legal for a bespoke agreement — please flag early if that will be required.

Proposed path forward (timeline):
1) Today: I will pre-fill key sections of your VSQ (we've filled the SOC 2 and encryption sections attached).
2) By EOD today: David will upload a one-page SOC 2 artifact and an engineering security FAQ.
3) Monday 26 Apr: Kimberly will prepare the DPA with SCC module appended and flag likely redlines so Pillar legal can review.
4) Wed 28 Apr: 15–20 min sync (if helpful) to confirm any remaining redlines.

Action items for you (Samir): please confirm the Pillar legal reviewer and the preferred secure upload method for the SOC 2 report (SFTP / OneDrive / secure portal).

Attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire-filled.xlsx (partial pre-fill), redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf

Thanks,
Elliot

Subject: Internal: PillarHealth DPA / SOC2 next steps (please review)

Team — looping you both with the agreed path below and immediate asks from Pillar:

Recap: Pillar (security lead Samir) is the primary reviewer; they expect Redwood to act as processor for hosted API. They asked for: SOC 2 summary artifact, DPA with SCC (2021) module, and the vendor questionnaire pre-filled.

Immediate asks: 
- David: please upload a one-page SOC 2 artifact (audit date + in-scope systems) and a short engineering FAQ (2–3 bullets on key controls). Target: today EOD. This will be shared with Pillar’s secure upload channel.
- Kimberly: please prepare the DPA with the 2021 SCC processor-to-controller module appended, note any clauses likely to be redlined (data deletion, subprocessors, export controls). Target: Monday 26 Apr.
- Elliot (me): I will pre-fill the VSQ and schedule the 15–20 min sync for Wed 28 Apr.

CC: Samir / Pillar legal — tagging so you see the internal plan and timelines.

Thanks — let me know if timeline friction; otherwise we'll proceed as above.

Best,
Elliot
